full_page.content:
Bles'd be God in His every design!
June 7th, 1948
God bless you Mrs. Grondin - you and yours.
I just came across your pathetic letter of Nov. 12th '47 and was wonder- ing what might have come to your little Dan. Not sure if I ever sent you an enrollment card for the Seraphic Mass Association, I am sending you one now. At all events I would be pleased to know if little Danny is still living or is he already gone to Heaven - for to die in a state of such innocence as he was in, and his physical condition, would mean that he would go to Heaven at once. In such a case, how supremely for- tunate for the little saint! Also how fortunate the parents .. .. I hope too, your new Baby is already able to fill your home with sunshine.
Again God bless you all.
Praised be Jesus.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
